description: Out-of-the-box coding benchmark: each task carries a held-out check oracle (executed against the candidate, never imported by it) and a reference solution. Scored in artifact_in mode; deterministic + credential-free.
name: coding_starter

guards.sentinel: a no-op or fake-success candidate must fail the held-out checks

tasks.instruction: Implement a function fib(n) that returns the nth Fibonacci number where fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1, fib(3)=2, ...

guards.sentinel: a no-op or fake-success candidate must fail the held-out checks

tasks.instruction: Implement fizzbuzz(n): return 'Fizz' if n is divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by both, otherwise the string form of n.

guards.sentinel: a no-op or fake-success candidate must fail the held-out checks

tasks.instruction: Implement is_palindrome(s): return True if s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and any non-alphanumeric characters; otherwise False.
